correctness.rationale: Center at A^{-1}b. On coordinate i the i.i.d. update is (y,z) -> (y−βξz,y), ξ Bernoulli(p_i). With h=βp/(1+βp) and c=h+β²p/2, Q=[[1,−h],[−h,c]] is positive definite since c>h>h². Direct expansion of the conditional Q-energy gives drift (β²p/2−h)(y²+z²); the mixed term cancels by βp(1−h)=h. Its sign is exactly that of pβ²+β−2. Comparison of Q with the Euclidean square gives geometric decay, exact conservation, or geometric growth for the state pair. At and above threshold the instantaneous mean square is also bounded below by a positive constant times the preceding pair's mean square: (1−p)y²+p(y−βz)² is positive definite because 0<p<1. Finite summation with fixed positive a_i, decreasing βcrit(p), and nonzero starts supported on a maximizing coordinate give the global frontier. The expansion at p=1/n is correct. Verification notes and rational checker were inspected, not executed; the all-time result is algebraic.
